# Generated by loopt. Edit the source under .loopt/workflows and run loopt gen.
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches:
    - main
  pull_request: {}
  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    name: test
    runs-on:
    - self-hosted
    - preloop-cpane
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec
      with:
        toolchain: '1.97'
        components: rustfmt,clippy
    - name: Format
      run: cargo fmt --all --check
    - name: Clippy
      run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
    - name: Test
      run: cargo test --locked --lib --tests
    - name: Build
      run: cargo build --locked
    - name: Language toolchains
      run: node --version && python3 --version && go version
    - name: Loopt version
      run: ./target/debug/loopt --version

# Generated by loopt. Edit the source under .loopt/workflows and run loopt gen.
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags:
    - v*
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  publish:
    name: publish
    runs-on:
    - self-hosted
    - preloop-cpane
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec
      with:
        toolchain: '1.97'
    - name: Build release binary
      run: cargo build --locked --release
    - name: Package
      run: mkdir -p dist && asset="loopt-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" && tar -czf "dist/$asset" -C target/release loopt && (cd dist && sha256sum "$asset" > "$asset.sha256")
    - name: Publish release asset
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      run: gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GH_REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GH_REPO" --title "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --generate-notes; gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GH_REPO" dist/* --clobber
